newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tsingtao's Shenzhen JV changes partner.
newsitem.headline: Tsingtao's Shenzhen JV changes partner.

text.p: Tsingtao Brewery Co Ltd said on Wednesday Pine Seal Investment Ltd (PSI) had replaced Pine Seal Development Ltd (PSD) in a brewery joint venture in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen.
"PSD withdrew from the Shenzhen Tsingtao project on its own accord," Tsingtao said in a statement. "PSD's position was replaced by PSI, who became a new joint venture party."
"This change is a commercial arrangement made after the negotiation by one of the shareholders of PSD, Sun Bao Gang, with the company," Tsingtao said.
PSD is equally owned by Sun and a nominee company.
Sun owns 36 percent of PSI, his wife Wen Jie owns 14 percent and third party Cheung Kung Tai owns 50 percent. Sun and Cheung are Hong Kong residents and mainland property developers.
Tsingtao said the Shenzhen Tsingtao Beer Co Ltd joint venture would still have registered capital of US$30 million, of which 51 percent is attributable to the company and 49 percent to PSI.
The company said the joint venture -- which will produce and sell Tsingtao beer -- would expire in July 2024.
Tsingtao shares were down HK$0.025 at HK$3.075 on Wednesday.
